_readme: FIAT COUNTY STAGE PLATES (6 Nov; docs/design/county_stages.md §5): a plate for each County place's 2/3 and 3/3, 24 jobs at 744x320, $0.15 each (about $3.60).
Out art/fight_county/<place>_2_plate.png / _3_plate.png: the County stage key finds them by name and stands each on its place's own wall (art/fight_county/<place>_cover.png) - nothing to wire.

Each styled on ANOTHER place of its zone (palette only - the 6 Nov lesson: a plate styled on its own place's came back a near-copy), what must differ said in words. ++ --parallel 3. After Matt has read the slice on test art.
Regenerate with python3 tools/make_county_stage_plates_manifest.py; check with python3 tools/art_lint.py.

jobs.description: A first-person view at crouching eye level, as if from behind cover in a light-gun arcade game, looking into the cash office behind a motorway toll plaza's booths: a counter of blank cash tills with their drawers open, a squat safe standing open and empty, plain grey filing cabinets, a strip light, a small high window of grey sky, a dark corridor doorway on the left. Indoors, in a small office: no booths, no canopy, no road in view. Nobody in the scene, empty and waiting. No people or figures anywhere. Composed for three figures to stand in later: clear open ground in the middle distance just right of centre, a dark doorway or gap on the left side well down the scene, and room in the right foreground. The ground runs across the lower third; the horizon sits a third of the way down. One continuous scene edge to edge: no repeated sections, no seams. The painting fills the whole canvas right to all four edges: no border, no frame, no margin, no empty space around it. Any signs, boards or fascias are blank, with no lettering on them. The bottom fifth of the scene is plain open ground running to the frame's edge, nothing standing in the foreground: no walls, rubble or cover there, it is drawn over later. Only the palette, light and painting style of the style image - nothing of its view, its place or its subject, which is somewhere else entirely. A crouching viewpoint, with near, middle and far ground. The painting fills the whole canvas to all four edges, no border, frame or margin. Every board, panel, screen and label in it blank, no lettering, numbers or pictures anywhere. Realistic painted pixel art, soft overcast light, muted cool northern palette, worn and lived-in, post-collapse Britain on a grey day; no black outlines, not anime, not a cartoon, not glossy; no text, no logos.
